1.text: By the sun and its brightness

2.text: And [by] the moon when it follows it

3.text: And [by] the day when it displays it<sup foot_note="228242">1</sup>

footnotes.228242: - The earth. Also interpreted as the sun. The same applies to the following verse.

4.text: And [by] the night when it covers [i.e., conceals] it

5.text: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it

6.text: And [by] the earth and He who spread it

7.text: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it<sup foot_note="228243">1</sup>

footnotes.228243: - i.e., balanced and refined it, creating in it sound tendencies and consciousness.

8.text: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,

9.text: He has succeeded who purifies it,

10.text: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].

11.text: Thamūd denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,

12.text: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.<sup foot_note="228244">1</sup>

footnotes.228244: - To hamstring the she-camel which had been sent by Allāh as a sign to them.

13.text: And the messenger of Allāh [i.e., Ṣāliḥ] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allāh or [prevent her from] her drink."

14.text: But they denied him and hamstrung<sup foot_note="228245">1</sup> her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].

15.text: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.<sup foot_note="228246">1</sup>

footnotes.228246: - Allāh is not asked about what He does, but His servants will be asked. See 21:23.
